surface_request: Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.
plan:
SOURCE: Untrusted tar archive entries read from tar_path, including file paths, symbolic-link targets, and hard-link targets.
TRUST: dest_path is the sole trusted boundary; every entry path and every link target is untrusted until normalized and verified to remain strictly inside dest_path.
SINK: File write and link creation operations that place content beneath dest_path during extraction.
GUARD: Normalize each entry path and each link target; permit symbolic-link and hard-link members only when every normalized target remains inside dest_path; block path traversal and external references.
ORDER: Enumerate and validate every member and every link target against the containment rule before performing any extraction write.
EFFECT: Return True only if full validation succeeds and every member is extracted successfully; return False on any validation or extraction failure, ensuring no archive member is written outside dest_path.
END_PLAN
